profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Diverse background with over 12 years of Full Stack and 7 years of Database Administrator experience.Hands on experience in analyzing, designing and testing software. Possess expertise in Object Oriented Analysis/Design, skilled at progressing from problem statement to well documented design.Strong knowledge of C#, ASP. Net, JavaScript, SQL Server, Angular, Node.js, VB, VB.Net, Oracle, C, C++,  Microsoft Access, Visio, Sencha, and very flexible to operate any software/any programming language. Strong management skills, demonstrated proficiency in leading and mentoring individuals to maximize level of productivity, while forming cohesive team environments. Assist collection and documentation of users requirements. Research and evaluate a variety of software products. Enthusiastic, self-motivated, organized, team player, punctual, hard working, honest and a quick learner.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and lead software solutions by studying business needs and following the software development. 
Lead software solutions to access external Soap as well as Rest API in our projects.
Successfully upgraded Angular version for our product
Experience in testing changes made to product by other team members and find issues to decrease regression rate.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and lead software solutions by studying business needs and following the software development and API Services life cycle with C#.Net, ASP.NET, JavaScript, Angular, SQL Server, SQL Profiler, Node.js
Experience in testing changes made to product by other team members and find issues to decrease regression rate.
Experience in developing new features and accessing external APIs to get data into the applications.
Experience of creating documentation in Confluence after each new feature is developed.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and lead software solutions by studying business needs and following the software development and API Services lifecycle with C#.Net, ASP.NET, JavaScript, Angular, SQL Server, SQL Profiler
Determined operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, solution development and proposed solutions in the agile environment.
Helped guide new product ideas and the ability to quickly turn-around on important opportunities by developing technical solution, providing feasibility assessments, and executing software delivery with a focus on quality and performance
Mentor new team members to help them understand technical aspects of the products.
Experienced in building strong relational database using MSSQL 2005-2017
Experienced using SQL profiler
Experience building multi-tier, distributed web applications
Experience in multitenant servers and cloud application.
Good knowledge of MS Visual Studio, MS Office applications, Visual Code, Altova 
Experience using JIRA system.
Experience using Git and Bitbucket both Server based and cloud versions 
Strong analytical skills
Highly motivated, as well as quick to adapt to a team-oriented work environment

positions.title: SQL Developer
positions.description:
Developed web pages using ASP.NET, C#, AJAX, XML, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, MS Visual Studio, XSLT
Strong Experience of using SQL profiler to trace.
Enhance performance of existing code, upgrade it, and add new functionality to product.
Create and Modify complex Stored procedure, functions to process huge database.
Provided support and maintenance for existing applications.

positions.title: IT Developer
positions.description:
• Generating variety of reports through join multiple tables, sub query, where, having
conditions to limiting the information from database by using SQL programming
• Involved in all phases of SDLC, and gathered business requirements.
• Design/develop database using SQL SERVER.
• Creating complex T-SQL Stored Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Cursors, Tables, and
Views and other SQL joins and statements for applications.
• Created SSIS Packages for migration of data between MS SQL Server database and
other databases like MS Access, MS Excel and Flat Files
• Developed SSIS Packages using ADO.NET, Oracle Connection manager, OLEDB, file
system and Excel Connection manager.
• Developed custom Reports, Ad-hoc reports by using SQL Server Reporting Services
(SSRS).
• Validating and manipulating data in excel file, updating the existing data and insert new
information in database,verify the consistency and accuracy of the new records
• Maintained and modified application for employee management and inventory
management.
• Tested applications for consistency and maintaining process and standards depending
upon specifications

positions.title: Assistant Data Manager
positions.description: Database Management. Downloading data from ftp server, depending upon specification 	modifying, deleting and updating the data, printing it and uploading it. Printing data on Heidelberg digimaster printer.  Processing data in Excel, MS Access and MS Visual FoxPro database. Data processing using different third party software programs like 	Double Take, Right Fielder, Personator and StreetSweeper. Running address accuracy 	and LCP sorting using Streetsweeper.  Transfer data from one form to another. Creating monthly reports. Auditing work of data entry people for accuracy

positions.title: Software Programmer
positions.description:
Performed multifaceted programming and analysis from code development through acceptance testing on a number of projects						
•	Developed application in C++ to customize office business systems.
•	Developed graphical user interface for several projects in VB and developed a system for book store that automates its working in VB and Oracle 
•	Tested applications for consistency and maintaining process and standards depending upon specifications.
•	Write, modify, integrate and test software code
•	Made suggestions for software change and customization of existing program. Designing, developing and testing reports depending on requirements
•	Identify and communicate technical problems, processes and solutions
•	Prepare reports, manuals and other documentations on the status, operation and maintenance of software
